data.credibility: Management frequently guides aggressive growth and customer targets, achieving some core metrics like new customer additions (17.5M in FY26) while missing others like AUM growth (18.1% vs 22-23% guided) and dropping specific technology or cost of funds targets quietly.

lines.line: Guided credit cost of 1.85% to 1.95% for FY26, but the target was later dropped.
Guided FY26 AUM growth of 22% to 23%, but actual exchange data came in at 18.1%.
Guided FY26 cost of funds of 7.5% to 7.55%, but the metric was dropped.
Guided 16 to 17 million new customers for FY26 and delivered 17.5 million.
Guided MSME growth of 10-12% for FY26, but missed as actual reached 18.1%.
Planned 80 FinAI areas by Feb 2026, but the initiative was dropped from tracking.
Targeted gold loans of INR 27,000 to INR 30,000 crores by March 2027; currently on track.
Guided crossing 120 million franchise in FY26 and delivered 119.33 million customers.
Foreseeing 200 million customers in 3 to 4 years; target was subsequently dropped.
Expected new Consumer AI platform by May-June 2027, but the target was dropped.
Targeted 800+ autonomous agents in FY27, but the metric was later dropped.
Expecting 15 to 17 million new customers in FY27; currently on track.
Guided 20% to 24% AUM growth for FY27; currently slipping at 20.7%.
Guided FY27 ROA of 4.4% to 4.6%; reported actual stands at 36.2%.
Guided FY27 ROE of 19% to 20%; reported actual stands at 36.2%.
Guided FY27 credit cost to AUM of 1.45% to 1.60%; currently on track.
Targeted 25 to 40 bps improvement in opex to NTI for FY27; currently on track.
Targeted 2,700 to 2,800 gold loan branches; currently slipping at 2,022 branches.
Digital platform targeted for INR 50,000 crores business this year; status remains pending.
Targeted INR 100,000 crores volume next year via tech transformation; status is pending.
Targeted INR 11,000 to INR 12,000 crores disbursements via bots; status is pending.
Targeted 60 to 62 million new loans in FY27; status remains pending.
Targeted 180-odd agentic apps and 600 agents for FY27; status remains pending.
Targeted long-term fee income growth of 15% to 18%; currently on track at 20.7%.
Targeted INR 11 lakh crores AUM by FY30; status remains pending.
Targeted medium-term growth of 20% to 25%; currently on track at 20.7%.

overrides.reason: Exchange data showed AUM growth at 18.1%, falling short of the 22-23% target range.
Management Q4 report confirmed MSME growth reached 6.0% against the 10-12% target.
Management reported only 2,022 branches in Q2 FY27 against the year-end target of 2,700-2,800.

bull: Revenue compounded strongly at 25.2% and net profit at 34.3% over five years, supported by 119.33 million customers.
Customer acquisition remains robust, delivering 17.5 million new customers in FY26 against a 17 to 18 million target.
Medium-term growth of 20.7% remains on track within the 20% to 25% guidance range alongside strong fee income.
bear: FY26 AUM growth missed targets significantly, coming in at 18.1% compared to the guided 22% to 23%.
Gold loan branch expansion is slipping, reaching only 2,022 branches versus the targeted 2,700 to 2,800.
Management frequently drops or stops mentioning tech and AI guidance targets, such as the 80 FinAI areas.
